1001:
Expand each summand as (x+k-1)(x+k+1) = x^{2} + 2kx + k^{2} - 1 and sum over k = 1 to n.
Dividing the total by n gives x^{2} + (n+1)x + \frac{(n+1)(2n+1)}{6} - 5 = 0 with roots \alpha and \alpha + 2.
Root sum gives 2\alpha + 2 = -(n+1) so \alpha = \frac{-(n+3)}{2}, and the root product gives \frac{(n+3)(n-1)}{4} = \frac{(n+1)(2n+1)}{6} - 5.
This simplifies to n^{2} = 49, so n = 7 and \alpha = -5, giving n + \alpha = 2 → (C)

1071:

Molar mass of \text{CrCl}_{3} \cdot 6\text{H}_{2}\text{O} = 52 + 106.5 + 108 = 266.5 g mol^{-1}

Monochloro structural counts are 1 for cyclopentane, 4 for methylcyclobutane, 4 for ethylcyclopropane, 2 for 1,1-dimethyl and 3 for 1,2-dimethyl
